div.p: EXPLANATION OF COMPENSATION STRUCTURE AND EMPLOYEE BENEFITS
To facilitate an easy understanding of your compensation structure (Cost to Company, CTC), the various components have been categorized under the following broad heads:

1. Basic Salary
2. Flexible Allowance
3. Variable Pay
4. Retirals & Insurance Benefit
The details for each component falling under these heads are explained as following:

The Basic Salary is standard across organization and brought to a certain value of the CTC. Basic salary has an impact on various other components such as the PF contribution, Gratuity etc. and hence has to be balanced so as not to substantially reduce the employee take home salary.

Flexible allowance enables you to design your own compensation structure by providing an access to various benefits provided in BXI Tech. You can declare and distribute Flexible allowance amount across the various components, adhering to the defined entitlements by logging onto the Flexible Compensation Portal. Any undeclared amount will be paid along with the monthly salary as Flexible Allowance.
The components forming part of Flexible compensation plan are listed below:

a. House Rent Allowance (HRA):House Rent Allowance caters to the rental expenses of the employees accommodation. The HRA can be declared maximum up to 50% of the Basic Salary and is paid monthly. You can declare either Company Leased Accommodation or House Rent Allowance for your compensation structure.
b. Company Leased Accommodation (CLA): Company Leased Accommodation is to facilitate for you to find accommodation of their choice within the defined Company Leased Accommodation limits.

c. Leave Travel Assistance (LTA): Leave Travel allowance enables you to claim your holiday travel expenses. Declaration in LTA is allowed up to the maximum entitlement applicable as per your band eligibility. The procedure for claim will be as per the existing LTA rules. By default, LTA would be treated as reimbursement.

d. NPS Employer Contribution: A voluntary contribution pension system administered and regulated by the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA). Declaration in NPS Employer Contribution is allowed from 0% to 10% of Annual Basic Salary. You will need to follow PRAN generation process in NPS portal, post which declaration can be made in Flexible compensation portal.

e. Fuel and Car Maintenance charges reimbursements: You are entitled to reimbursement of fuel expenses and maintenance charges (w.r.t. repairs, spare parts, annual vehicle insurance etc.,) on your car up to per the maximum entitlements as per your band eligibility. For claiming this, you will have to submit original bills on a monthly basis or as and when you wish to get this amount reimbursed. By default, Fuel and Vehicle Maintenance would be treated as reimbursement.
f. Car Lease Rental Reimbursement: We have an attractive Car Lease Scheme, according to which you can avail the following facilities:

ul.li: You can select the model of the car within the limit prescribed in the scheme.
A Third-Party vendor will help you with the processing of the papers and other formalities.
The lease value up to the maximum limit as per your band-wise entitlements in the Flexible Compensation portal will be contributed towards the EMI.

div.p: By default, car lease rental will be paid as part of monthly salary and treated as a taxable component, unless lease value is finalized.

g. Food Wallet: Food Wallet is a voluntary benefit and is applicable for payments related to food and non-alcoholic beverages only. Once enrolled, the benefit should be availed within BXI Tech Cafeterias or food joints outside BXI Tech campus which serves only food and non-alcoholic beverages. This Food Wallet cannot be used in any other outlet other than designated food outlet.

h. Superannuation: Superannuation is a welfare scheme aimed to provide you social security post-retirement from your service. Contribution to Superannuation Fund can be made up to 15% of your basic salary with an upper ceiling of INR 1.50 Lacs.
The scope of "Variable Pay" in your compensation structure will be governed based on your "employee group" in BXI Tech.

ul.li: Performance Bonus (PB): Performance Bonus (PB) is payable in accordance with the Company Bonus Policy (sales / delivery / functional support) as applicable at that time. The quantum of pay-out will be subject to the current year Bonus Policy and will be calculated based on your individual contributions against your Key Performance Parameters (KPP) as well as the company performance.

div.p: PB is payable at the end of the performance review cycle. To be eligible for the bonus pay-out, you need to be active on the rolls of the company at the time of reward distribution as per Performance review and Reward cycle.

You and your dependents will be covered under Social Security as per the law and Insurance Benefits policy offered by the company. The amount mentioned under 'Insurance and Medical Benefits' in your compensation structure is applicable towards various insurances (Medical Insurance, Term Life Insurance, Personal Accident Insurance).

li.p:
Medical Insurance: Some of the salient features of the Group Health Medical Insurance policy are as follows:
The policy covers Hospitalization expenses and Maternity expenses.
By default, employees (who are not covered under the ESI Act, 1948) will be mandatorily covered under the benefit. The premium payable depends on the dependents declared.
Company reserves the right to amend the benefit plan and shall keep all employees informed/updated.
You may refer Medical Insurance policy for further details.

ul.p: b. Coverage under ESI: The employee will be covered under Employee State Insurance Scheme in accordance with the applicable norms and amendments made from time to time or any further amendment which may come into force during the employment tenure under Employees' State Insurance Act, 1948.

div.p: Employee & employer contributions will be as per prescribed ESI Rules. Employees covered under ESI would not be covered by default under BXI Tech medical insurance benefit. Option to enroll under medical insurance is available; however, in such a case, the additional cost of annual medical premium will be borne by the employee as per terms and conditions mentioned under Medical Insurance policy.
The employee & employer contribution will be payable as per current prescribed rates under ESI Rules.

3. Employer contribution to Provident Fund: As per statutory requirements, an employee has to contribute 12% of the basic salary towards Provident Fund (PF). BXI Tech contributes matching amount to PF.

Out of employer contribution, 8.33% of monthly basic or INR 1,250/- whichever is lower is remitted to PF authorities towards Employees' Pension Scheme (EPS). All employees are thereby eligible to draw pension after superannuation, except those who have opted out of EPS as per Form-11 declaration.
The percentage and amount are in compliance with the current PF Act and are subject to change as per amendment in the Act.

4. Gratuity: As per statutory requirements, it is the employer's statutory liability to pay 15 days' Basic salary (15/26 of monthly Basic) for every completed year of service to each employee on exit, for any reason after five years of continuous service, subject to a maximum limit of INR 20.00 lakhs.

5. Term Life Insurance (including EDLI): You will be covered under Term Life Insurance which provides a safety net to the family in case of death of the employee due to any reason. The applicable amount is mentioned in your offer letter.

6. Disability Insurance: You are also covered against any permanent or partial disability that may arise due to an accident. The amount payable by the insurer for a disability shall depend on the nature of the disability.
The amount mentioned in your offer letter is the maximum amount payable by the insurer as per the nature of disability. You may refer to the 'Personal Accident Insurance' policy for further details.

It is often said that an organization can grow only if it empowers its employees to grow. At BXI Tech, we consciously realize this fact and have developed a five-fold path for individual enlightenment that not only covers basic monetary benefits but also takes care of professional growth by providing empowerment, knowledge, recognition, transformation and support.
The following terms and conditions refer to our offer of employment to you and are to be read in conjunction with the offer letter attached.

p.strong: GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT

div.p: 1. Location: Your joining location will be .

2. Medical Check-up: Your employment may be subject to you being declared medically fit by a registered medical practitioner. The Company may request the same as and when required, as per Company Policies or client requirements.The fitness testing (and accompanying results) will not lead to any subjective,discriminatory or unethical actions.
3. Probation: You will be on probation for a period of 6 months from the date of your joining. Unless notified in writing, you will be deemed as "confirmed" on completion of your probation period.
4. Performance and Compensation Reviews: Your performance appraisal and compensation review will be governed by the Company's policy being in force from time to time.

5. Notice Period / Separation: Your employment with the Company can be terminated by either party by giving three months' advance notice. If the Company terminates employment and decides to relieve you before completion of the notice period, the "Basic" component of salary for the balance notice period will be paid to you. If you request early relieving, you will be liable to pay the Company the "Basic" component of salary for the balance notice period. Acceptance of early relieving is at the sole discretion of the Company. The 90 days' notice period may be extended if mutually agreed. On termination, you must complete all exit formalities, sign required documents, and return all Company property. Full and final settlement will be processed only after completion of separation procedures.

6. Agreements: You may be required to e-sign necessary agreements with the Company or client and complete all formalities at the time of joining and during the tenure of employment. You may also be required to sign other Agreements with the Company, as the Company may decide from time to time, in order to secure the interests of the Company as also to ensure your performance and adherence to all terms, conditions, rules and regulations of the Company.

7. Employment of Relatives: At the time of joining, you must declare your family members / relatives working in a direct or indirect supervisory / subordinate relationship or as third-party resources in the same work unit (Respective L3 Organization Unit Level). This is required to avoid any conflict of interest. During employment, if any of your direct relatives are offered employment by BXI Tech or any of its subsidiary, group, or affiliate companies, you must voluntarily declare the same when the offer is made. Direct relatives include parents, spouse, brothers, sisters, and children of the employee.

ul.li: The Company will undertake background verification / validation including education, previous employment(s), criminal verification, database and web searches, address verification, and claims made in resumes/CVs through a third-party agency as and when required.You will be required to submit copies of documents listed in Annexure IV to facilitate joining and background verification.
The Company may also undertake reference checks through at least two professional references submitted during selection.
In case the prospective employee fails to submit required documents for background verification, they will not be considered for hiring.

If the prospective employee fails the background verification process, the employment offer may be withdrawn.Appropriate actions including withdrawal of offer of employment will be taken based on the recommendations given by the background verification team and in line with BXI Tech policies.

div.p: You will be governed by the normal working hours as existing in the company. You may be required to work in shifts and/or extended working hours, as permitted by law, based on business requirements. These are subject to change from time to time.

The Company may require you to perform duties and undertake assignments in any part of India or abroad, either at Company premises or client/customer locations. You may also be transferred to any office or branch of the Company anywhere in India or abroad. During deputation to client/customer premises, you shall abide by the applicable terms and conditions of such premises.

The Company may depute you to any Group Company or transfer your services to any Group Company. On such transfer, the current employment terms will cease and new terms of the transferee Company will apply. However, continuity of service will be maintained.
You will retire from service on attaining superannuation at the age of 58 years.

You shall be eligible for other benefits including leaves, perquisites, etc. in accordance with prevailing Company policies. The Company reserves the right to modify these benefits as and when required and you will be informed accordingly.

You have been appointed on the presumption that the particulars furnished in your application and resume are correct. In the event that the said particulars are found to be incorrect, or if you have concealed or withheld any relevant facts, your appointment with the Company shall stand terminated/cancelled without any notice.

This Annexure contains the Employee Undertakings which set forth certain employee obligations with respect to the protection of confidential information and legitimate business interests of the Company.
As a condition of my employment and/or continued employment with the Company and my receipt of compensation, I agree to the following:

Company Information: I shall not use, communicate, or disclose, except for the benefit of the Company, any Confidential Information relating to the Company, its corporate parent, or any of their affiliates. Subsidiaries or affiliates (collectively "Company Parties"), to which I have been privy to by virtue of being an employee of the Company. I understand that "Confidential Information" for this purpose shall mean and include all information, regardless of the form whether oral, written, stored in a computer database or otherwise, which in any way relates to markets, customers (including but not limited to customers of any of the Company Parties with whom I interacted or became acquainted while associated with the Company), products, patents, inventions, know-how, software, procedures, methods, designs, strategies, plans, assets, liabilities, revenues, pricing lists, customer information, profits, organization, employees, agents, distributors, or business in general of any of the Company Parties. I understand that Confidential Information and trade secrets do not include any of the items mentioned above which have become publicly known and made generally available through no wrongful act of mine or others who were under confidentiality obligations. I hereby agree to maintain the secrecy and confidentiality of such Confidential Information.

Former Employer Information: I agree that I will not, during my employment with the Company, improperly use or disclose any proprietary information or trade secrets of any former or concurrent employer or any other person or entity. Further, I will not bring into the Company premises any proprietary information or trade secret of any such employer, person, or entity unless consented to in writing by such employer, person, or entity.

Third Party Information: I recognize that the Company has received and in the future will receive from third parties their confidential or proprietary information subject to a duty to maintain confidentiality and to use such information only for limited purposes. I agree to maintain the confidentiality of such third-party information and to use it only as permitted by the Company. Hold all such confidential or proprietary information in the strictest confidence and agree not to disclose it to any person, corporation, or entity. I also agree not to use such information except as necessary in carrying out my work for the Company consistent with the Company's agreement with such third party.

Inventions Retained and Licensed: I have shared and declared a list describing all inventions, original works of authorship, developments, improvements, and trade secrets which were made by me prior to my employment with the Company (collectively referred to as "Prior Inventions"), which belong to me, which relate to the Company's proposed business, products, or research and development, and which are not assigned to the Company hereunder. If no such list is attached, I represent that there are no such Prior Inventions. If in the course of my employment with the Company I incorporate into a Company product, process, or machine a Prior Invention owned by me or in which I have an interest, the Company is hereby granted a nonexclusive, royalty-free, irrevocable, perpetual, worldwide license to make, have made, modify, use, and sell such Prior Invention as part of or in connection with such product, process, or machine.

Assignment of Inventions: I agree that I will promptly make full written disclosure to the Company, which will hold in trust for the sole right and benefit of the Company, and hereby assign to the Company, or its designee, all my right, title, and interest in and to any and all inventions, original works of authorship, developments, concepts, improvements, or trade secrets. This includes whether or not patentable or registrable under copyright or similar laws, which I may solely or jointly conceive, develop, or reduce to practice, or cause to be conceived or developed. Reduced to practice during the period of my employment with the Company (collectively referred to as "Inventions"), except as provided in sub-section (e) below. I further acknowledge that all original works of authorship created by me (solely or jointly with others) within the scope of and during the period of my employment with the Company, and which are protectable by copyright, are considered "works made for hire" as defined under applicable copyright laws.

Maintenance of Records: I agree to keep and maintain adequate and current written records of all Inventions made by me (solely or jointly with others) during the term of my employment with the Company. The records will be maintained in the form of notes, sketches, drawings, or any other format as specified by the Company, and shall remain available to the Company at all times. Such records shall always remain the sole property of the Company.

Patent and Copyright Registrations: I agree to assist the Company, or its designee, at the Company's expense, in every proper way to secure the Company's rights in the Inventions and any related copyrights, patents, mask work rights, or other intellectual property rights in any country. This includes disclosing all necessary information and executing all applications, specifications, oaths, assignments, and other instruments required to obtain such rights and assign them fully to the Company, its successors, assigns, or nominees. I further agree that my obligation to execute such documents shall continue even after termination of my employment with the Company. If the Company is unable to secure any rights due to my unavailability or incapacity, I hereby designate and appoint the Company as my attorney-in-fact to act on my behalf to execute such documents and take necessary actions to protect such rights. Incapacity or for any other reason to fail to secure my signature to apply for or to pursue any application for local or foreign patents or copyright registrations covering Inventions or original works of authorship assigned to the Company. I hereby irrevocably designate and appoint the Company and its duly authorized officers and agents as my agent and attorney-in-fact, to act on my behalf to execute and file such applications and to perform all lawful acts necessary to further the prosecution and issuance of patents or copyright registrations, with the same legal force and effect as if executed by me.

Exception to Assignments: I understand that the provisions requiring assignment of Inventions to the Company do not apply to any invention for which no Company equipment, supplies, facilities, or trade secret information was used and which was developed entirely on my own time.
However, this exception does not apply if:

ul.li: (i) At the time the Invention was conceived or reduced to practice, it related directly to the business of the Company or to its actual or anticipated research and development.
(ii) The Invention resulted from any work performed by me for the Company.

div.p: I further understand that applicable laws may restrict assignment of such Inventions. I will promptly inform the Company in writing of any inventions that meet the criteria of this exception.

I agree that upon leaving the employment of the Company, I will deliver to the Company and will not retain, recreate, or distribute any Company property. This includes all devices, records, data, notes, reports, proposals, lists, correspondence, specifications, drawings, blueprints, sketches, materials, software, databases, equipment, and any other documents or property, including copies or reproductions, developed by me during my employment. Pursuant to my employment with the Company or otherwise belonging to the Company, its successors or assigns.
If I leave the employment of the Company, I hereby grant consent to the Company to notify my new employer about my rights and obligations under this agreement.

For a period of six (6) months after termination of my employment or cessation of my association with the Company for any reason whatsoever, I shall not directly or indirectly solicit, or cause or authorize to be solicited, for employment any employee of the Company. I shall also not employ or engage any such employee on my own behalf or on behalf of any third party. I further agree not to use or disclose to any third party any information obtained during my employment concerning the names and addresses of past or present employees of the Company.

During the six (6) months immediately following termination of my employment with the Company, and unless expressly authorized in writing, I shall not directly or indirectly perform any similar services for any competing organization. This includes any current or former customer and/or prospect of the Company with whom I have worked during the past twelve (12) months.
For the purposes of these non-compete provisions, "Similar Services" means services which meet any of the following criteria:

ul.li: Work in competing business/products (e.g., Digital Business, Security, Customer Experience, Marketing, etc.) or sector (e.g., Financial Services) in which I worked for the Company;
Where the nature of work remains the same (e.g., selling ITBS services, Product Architect) and involves the same end clients or prospects; and
Is performed in the same geography or market where I provided services for the Company.

div.p: The Company reserves the right to unilaterally waive this restriction in full or in part at its discretion. The Employee hereby acknowledges and agrees to the same.
In case the Company initiates separation by way of involuntary termination or redundancy, this non-compete clause shall not apply.
7. General Provisions Regarding Covenants

Extension of Covenants: If I breach any of my obligations under this Annexure, I understand and agree that the time periods of the obligations breached shall be extended by the duration of such breach.

Attachment Read, Understood and Fair: I confirm that I have carefully read and understood the provisions of this Annexure and agree that all restrictions set forth are fair, reasonable, and necessary for the protection of the Company's interests and goodwill.
8. Protection of Systems & Environment

I agree that during the term of my employment or association with the Company, I shall render services in an ethical and professional manner and in accordance with all work-related policies of the Company, including but not limited to E-mail & Internet Usage Policy, Information Security Policy, and any modifications made from time to time. As part of my job responsibilities, I may be required to access or use Company systems, data, or infrastructure. I undertake to use such resources responsibly and strictly for official purposes in compliance with Company guidelines.Customer's work and computer environment and, as such, I undertake not to incorporate into the Company's or any customer deliverables any software, computer code, network component, data, or other electronically stored information containing any security risk. This includes, without limitation, any security device, malicious program routine, code, or instructions (including those provided by third parties), or any undisclosed feature such as: Time bomb,Virus,Software lock / drop-dead device,Digital Rights Management tools (including DRM rootkits),Malicious logic, worm, Trojan horse, or trap door Or any other routine, device, or code capable of accessing, modifying, deleting, damaging, disabling, interfering with, or otherwise harming any software, systems, networks, deliverables, or data. I understand that any violation of this clause may expose the Company to significant losses, including claims from customers, and the Company shall be entitled to recover all such damages from me.
9. Remedies

By virtue of my duties and responsibilities, I understand that any breach of this Annexure may result in irreparable damage to the Company. I acknowledge that these terms are necessary to protect the Company's interests. Therefore, in addition to all other remedies available under law, the Company shall be entitled to: Specific performance,Temporary restraining orders,Permanent injunctions These remedies may be enforced without the requirement of posting any bond, to prevent or stop any breach of this Agreement.
10. Representations

I represent that my performance of all the terms of my employment agreement and this Annexure will not breach any confidentiality agreements entered into prior to my employment with the Company.I have not entered into, and will not enter into, any oral or written agreement that conflicts with the provisions of the undertakings mentioned in this Annexure.
11. Integration

I understand and agree that this Annexure forms an integral part of my employment agreement with the Company. The general provisions of the Agreement, including but not limited to reformation and severability, shall apply while interpreting this Annexure.
